stories.title: 黄仁勋峰会现场接到特朗普电话，当场打开免提：“机器人不会接管世界”

en.title: Huang Receives Trump Call at Summit, Puts on Speakerphone: "Robots Won't Take Over the World"
en.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang received a phone call from U.S. President Trump during the All-in Summit in Los Angeles on September 14, which he answered on speakerphone. The two discussed artificial intelligence development.

stories.title: 国家统计局：智能绿色商品消费日益成为消费市场新亮点

en.title: National Bureau of Statistics: Consumption of Smart and Green Products Becomes New Highlight in Consumer Market
en.summary: China's National Bureau of Statistics reported that consumption-expanding policies have been actively implemented this year, with efforts to increase quality supply, promote product trade-in programs, and tap service consumption potential. Smart and green product consumption has emerged as a new growth driver in the overall stable consumer market.

stories.title: Chinese plant extracts critical rare metals from lithium waste in world first

en.title: Chinese plant extracts critical rare metals from lithium waste in world first
en.summary: China has opened a 500-tonne production line in Jiangxi province that extracts rubidium and caesium from lithium waste, marking the world's first facility of its kind for continuous extraction and separation of these materials used in aerospace, quantum computing, and biomedicine.

stories.title: Hong Kong leader vows accountability over faulty lifts at Queen Mary Hospital

en.title: Hong Kong leader vows accountability over faulty lifts at Queen Mary Hospital
en.summary: Hong Kong's Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu has ordered an investigation into faulty lift installations at Queen Mary Hospital's new building, vowing to hold construction firms and government personnel accountable for the problems.

stories.title: 国家统计局：房地产交易总量有所改善、趋于稳定

en.title: National Bureau of Statistics: Real Estate Transaction Volume Shows Some Improvement, Trending Toward Stability
en.summary: China's National Bureau of Statistics reported that real estate transaction volumes have improved and are stabilizing. Authorities have implemented tailored policies across regions, controlled new supply, reduced inventory, and promoted housing system reforms to establish new development models.

stories.title: A股午评：超3900只个股飘绿，深指收涨，沪指、创业板指收跌

en.title: A-Share Midday Review: Over 3,900 Stocks in Red, Shenzhen Index Rises, Shanghai Index and ChiNext Index Fall
en.summary: Chinese stock markets showed mixed performance with over 3,900 stocks declining. Storage chip stocks strengthened alongside power generation equipment and semiconductors, while restaurant, tourism, agricultural, and insurance sectors fell.

stories.title: 青岛：碱蓬草染红河海滩涂 红海滩迎来最佳观赏季

en.title: Qingdao: Suaeda Salsa Turns River and Beach Red, Red Beach Enters Peak Viewing Season
en.summary: Halophyte vegetation has created red-colored coastal areas in Qingdao, attracting visitors during the peak seasonal viewing period for this natural phenomenon.

stories.title: 化石破碎线索稀缺 揭秘科研人员如何复原消失的奥氏马

en.title: Sparse Fossil Fragmentation Clues: Researchers Reveal How They Restored the Extinct Equus sanmeniensis
en.summary: Jilin University's bioarchaeology laboratory, partnering with an American company, completed the world's first complete morphological reconstruction of the extinct ancient horse species Equus sanmeniensis.

stories.title: 从亏本养殖到年入百万 看戈壁牧民夫妇如何凭一杯驼奶逆袭致富

en.title: From Loss-Making Livestock Farming to Annual Income of One Million: How a Gobi Herding Couple Achieved Wealth Through Camel Milk
en.summary: A herding couple in the Gobi region transformed their livestock operation from unprofitable to generating annual income exceeding one million by focusing on camel milk production.

stories.title: 海南万宁突现龙卷风 无人员伤亡

en.title: Tornado Suddenly Appears in Wanning, Hainan; No Casualties Reported
en.summary: A tornado struck the Yongfan community area of Wanning city in Hainan province, with the primary impact zone being Beijing Normal University Wanning Experimental School, resulting in no reported injuries.

stories.title: 李家超：香港第一个五年规划封面为蓝色，代表开放、进步、稳重

en.title: Lee Ka-chao: Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan Cover is Blue, Representing Openness, Progress, and Steadfastness
en.summary: Hong Kong's Chief Executive Lee Ka-chao announced that the cover of Hong Kong's first five-year plan will be blue to symbolize openness, progress, and steadfastness, while the 2026 policy address cover will retain green to represent policy continuity, vitality, and hope.

stories.title: 四问四答 带您了解平陆运河为何而建

en.title: Four Questions and Four Answers: Understanding Why the Pinglu Canal is Being Built
en.summary: Construction experts explain the rationale behind the Pinglu Canal, China's first nationally coordinated river-to-sea waterway project since the founding of the People's Republic, including its location in Guangxi and its origins.

stories.title: China targets offshore operations of brokerages in crackdown on pay loopholes, corruption

en.title: China targets offshore operations of brokerages in crackdown on pay loopholes, corruption
en.summary: China's securities regulator is extending anti-corruption oversight to brokerage overseas operations for the first time, aiming to close compensation loopholes for management and staff as part of efforts to develop world-class investment banks.

stories.title: New York City’s rich Chinese grapple with Beijing tax rules as enforcement deadline nears

en.title: New York City's rich Chinese grapple with Beijing tax rules as enforcement deadline nears
en.summary: Beijing's new tax rules on offshore trusts, effective July 24, are affecting wealthy mainland Chinese residents in New York City, imposing a 20 percent tax on realized gains and annual taxes on income from such trusts.

stories.title: Hong Kong malls see ‘gradual recovery’ with new stores and events: Hang Lung CEO

en.title: Hong Kong malls see 'gradual recovery' with new stores and events: Hang Lung CEO
en.summary: Hong Kong shopping mall operators are experiencing improving conditions with growth recorded in July. According to Hang Lung Properties' CEO, malls can thrive by opening new stores and hosting events to compete with cross-border shopping preferences.

stories.title: China’s inbound tourism revenue projected to reach US$470 billion by 2040: UBS

en.title: China's inbound tourism revenue projected to reach US$470 billion by 2040: UBS
en.summary: UBS forecasts China's inbound tourism revenue will more than double to US$470 billion by 2040, growing at an annual rate of 8.9 percent and representing 15 percent of global tourism market share.

stories.title: Forms Syntron draws Hong Kong’s next-gen tycoons in HK$940 million IPO

en.title: Forms Syntron draws Hong Kong's next-gen tycoons in HK$940 million IPO
en.summary: Hong Kong's younger business leaders are increasingly participating in IPO markets through family offices and private investments, with their capital extending into technology and digital finance sectors rather than traditional property and finance.
